runs.name: control
wave2_titles: Approve must return a definitive answer before the client deadline, and exactly one payment must have landed
Two simultaneous approvals of one invoice must produce exactly one payment
The API's live approved claim must be backed by a re-read of persisted state

runs.name: nonidempotent-a
wave2_titles: Two approvals of one invoice race — exactly one payment must persist
Approving one invoice under two different actors pays once
Four repeated approvals do not accumulate a growing ledger
Repeated approvals of one invoice leave an untouched invoice pending

runs.name: nonidempotent-b
wave2_titles: Two simultaneous approvals of one invoice pay exactly once
Approval survives an api restart without duplicating the payment
Re-approving after a restart still pays once
Approving one invoice does not create a payment on another

runs.name: nonidempotent-c
wave2_titles: Two simultaneous approvals of one invoice pay exactly once
A single approval records exactly one approval, durably
A single approval survives an api restart as exactly one
Duplicate approvals do not become durable across a restart

runs.name: ui_lies-a

Two simultaneous approvals of one invoice record at most one
Re-approving after a restart does not double-pay
Approvals of distinct invoices persist independently

runs.name: ui_lies-b
wave2_titles: Approval survives an api restart

Approving increments the durable approvals counter
Approving twice records exactly one approval

SMOKE invoice approval reaches the durable store

runs.name: ui_lies-c
wave2_titles: Approve success response must match durable store
Approval survives an api restart
Approval stable across independent re-reads

Persisted flag not emitted for a target never recorded

Two simultaneous approvals of one invoice pay exactly once
